meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: One of the first functions assigned to mTORC2 was shaping the cell's skeleton. In yeast it was the original TOR2 phenotype; in mammalian cells it showed that the second complex is acutely rapamycin-insensitive.
data.mechanism_beginner: mTORC2's first known job was shaping the cell's internal skeleton – noticed precisely because rapamycin didn't block it.
data.note: The two-complex model itself came from biochemistry (LOE2002, JAC2004, SAR2004).
